claim: A building wall that should have no windows (a flank, a side wall over rock) wears the same facade tile without the window, not a different brick. The owner named one such pair, 380 (with windows) and 381 (without); facade_pass.BLANK_OF also pairs 384/385, 393/394 and 397/396, read off the art by us, not by him; 400 and 401 have no companion found.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-19, walking Gravesend: '380 is building facade with windows and 381 is the same thing just without windows, so if you want to have just a wall of that building it should have this texture to look good' (projects/blood-city/level/facade_pass.py:43-46, l3_market.py:357-358).
projects/blood-city/level/facade_pass.py:49 BLANK_OF: the three other pairs are read off the art (comment at :45-48).
use: Look for the companion tile of a facade before choosing a flank material.

checked.how: Opened projects/blood-city/level/facade_pass.py:40-49 and l3_market.py:350-358: the owner's words, 2026-11-19, name only 380 (windows) and 381 (without); BLANK_OF = {380:381, 384:385, 393:394, 397:396}, the comment says the other three pairs were read off the art; 400 and 401 have no companion. Memory note split-bands-and-blank-companions.md says the same.
